definitions: A fictional high street located in London, accessible to witches and wizards, where they can purchase magical supplies.
A hidden magical marketplace described in the Harry Potter series of books and films.
examples: Harry first visited Diagon Alley to buy his school supplies.
Many shops in Diagon Alley sell wands and spellbooks.
The entrance to Diagon Alley is hidden behind the Leaky Cauldron.
